title: Aspire Zelos 3 Vape Kit
description: Aspire’s latest vape kit, the hugely impressive Zelos 3, is built for incredible performance and ease-of-use. A mighty 3200mAh internal battery ensures the Zelos 3 can easily last all day, while USB-C type charging means the Zelos 3 can be recharged in no time at all. The kit can be adjusted up to a max output of 80 watts, aided by Aspire’s advanced ASP chipset which incorporates a host of safety features and intelligent functions, including coil recognition and a choice of output settings such as Variable Voltage, Bypass Mode and TC Mode All your information is displayed on a crystal-clear 0.96in colour TFT screen, and you can choose from 5 screen colour themes as well as being able to adjust the brightness. The Aspire Zelos 3 kit is crowned with latest iteration of a truly legendary tank: the Aspire Nautilus 3. The 2ml Nautilus 3 Tank offers an adjustable airflow with seven airflow inlet holes ranging from 0.8mm to 3mm, providing unparalleled control to let you perfect your ultimate vape.Easy to refill, the Nautilus 3 features a convenient top-fill system. The Nautilus 3 is also compatible with all of Aspire’s celebrated Nautilus series coils and Triton coils enabling you to explore a huge variety of MTL and DL, sub-ohm vaping styles , and all the coils are easy to replace thanks to the tank’s press-coil installation feature.With the Zelos 3 starter kit, Aspire have proved that they are still at the forefront of vaping with a fabulous kit that’s versatile enough for every vaper while still delivering unbeatable performance. Explore our vaping juice UK and discover the ideal match for this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
